name: select_request_slot
description: Picks one of four 68-byte request slots by index, or clears the whole slot table when given the all-ones sentinel. For a real slot it waits on any pending exec I/O for that slot, then fills in its fields, and when the last slot is chosen it binds a bit mask and a buffer to each of the four slots in a loop.

name: open_dos_library_base
description: Opens dos.library through the exec OpenLibrary vector and stores the returned library base pointer in a global.

name: open_intuition_library_base
description: Opens intuition.library through the exec OpenLibrary vector and stores the returned base pointer in a global.

name: close_library_via_exec
description: Closes a library through the exec CloseLibrary vector, using the base pointer held in a global.

name: open_graphics_library_base
description: Opens graphics.library through the exec OpenLibrary vector and stores the returned base pointer in a global.

name: close_library_via_exec
description: Closes a library through the exec CloseLibrary vector, using the base pointer held in a global.

name: open_diskfont_library_base
description: Opens diskfont.library through the exec OpenLibrary vector and stores the returned base pointer in a global.

name: close_library_via_exec
description: Closes a library through the exec CloseLibrary vector, using the base pointer held in a global.

name: open_iff_library_or_fallback
description: Opens iff.library and stores its base pointer in a global, and when the open returns nothing it points a global at the shared fallback data area instead.

name: close_library_via_exec
description: Closes a library through the exec CloseLibrary vector, using the base pointer held in a global.

name: size_music_buffer_from_free_memory
description: Reads free memory through the exec AvailMem vector and chooses one of six size tiers from the result. When the top tier fits, it allocates a buffer with AllocMem, records the offsets of up to six regions inside it, and the file name MegaBall.Music is referenced in the same routine.

name: open_and_read_scores_file
description: Copies a fixed-length block of longs within the global data area, then opens MegaBall.scores and, when the open succeeds, reads from it and closes it.

name: write_scores_file
description: Opens MegaBall.scores and, when the open succeeds, writes to it through the DOS write vector and then closes it.

name: read_iff_color_table
description: Calls the iff.library colour-table routine for the image handle and, when that call fails, sets the shared failure pointer and closes the IFF handle. The referenced file name BALL2.IFF is the image this works on.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Does nothing: it is a single return instruction with no library calls, reached from two places.

name: decode_iff_picture
description: Calls the iff.library picture-decoding routine on the open IFF handle and, when decoding fails, sets the shared failure pointer and closes the handle.

name: open_custom_screen
description: Opens a custom intuition screen through the OpenScreen vector, and when that returns nothing it sets the shared failure pointer.

name: open_intuition_window
description: Opens an intuition window through the OpenWindow vector and stores the returned window pointer in a global.

name: open_main_window
description: Opens the main intuition window through the OpenWindow vector, stores the window pointer, and sets the shared failure pointer when no window is returned.

name: next_random_in_range
description: Advances a 32-bit seed built by mixing several state words with multiply and xor steps, then returns a 16-bit value taken modulo the range in the low word of its input. The quotient is packed in the upper half of the result.

name: call_handler_if_enabled
description: Checks a flag word and calls the wrapped routine only when the flag is non-zero; otherwise it returns straight away.

name: call_handler_if_enabled
description: Checks a flag word and calls the wrapped routine only when the flag is non-zero; otherwise it returns straight away.

name: invoke_handler_return_zero
description: Calls the routine it wraps and returns zero, and it is reached through a pointer stored in the data area.

name: forward_call_keep_registers
description: Calls a single routine and returns with the register result unchanged, and it has four callers.

name: build_byte_indexed_pointer_table
description: Runs two setup calls and clears four counters, then walks a byte table in the data area and fills a table of 30 pointer entries that point into rows of the data area. It clears the global state words afterwards and sets a flag word to 1.

name: build_byte_indexed_pointer_table
description: Clears four counters and runs a setup call, then walks a byte table in the data area and fills 30 pointer entries that point into rows of the data area. It clears the global state words afterwards and sets a flag word to 1.

name: clear_audio_state_if_active
description: When the active flag is set, it clears that flag, resets four state words and writes a fixed value into a global with one bit cleared. The facts also list the audio volume registers and the fire-button port as touched by this area.

name: update_audio_channel_pointers
description: When the active flag is set and the paused flag is clear, it advances a step counter. On the wrap-around path it runs eight helper routines, and on the other path it writes pairs of values from a table into the four audio channel location registers, with fixed delay loops around the writes.

name: process_tracker_channel_effect
description: Reads a four-byte entry for one channel, stores its period and sample offset, then decodes the effect nibble. Effect codes set an audio filter bit, invert a flag, store a level clamped to 64, or store a speed clamped to 31, and the remaining codes call helper routines.

name: copy_word_field_to_pointer
description: Copies one 16-bit field from a record at a fixed offset into the location supplied through a pointer register.

name: scale_value_by_global_factor
description: Multiplies a 16-bit value read through a pointer by a global scale factor, shifts the product right by four bits, and stores it in a field of the record.

name: compare_record_period_to_target
description: Takes the low 12 bits of a record's first word, stores them in a second field, and compares them with a target field. An equal value resets the result field, and a smaller value sets a flag.

name: run_channel_period_effect_tick
description: Runs one tick of a channel's per-step effect selected by its effect nibble. It slides the stored period down or up within fixed limits, steps through a lookup table, or applies one of several table-driven adjustments, then writes the period and level back to the channel record.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Contains only a halt on bad instruction data, so the decoder reached it through a gap and no behaviour can be read from it.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: The decoded code is only a halt on bad instruction data, so no behaviour can be read from it. The listed list-insertion, memory-allocation and task-lookup calls come from the facts, not from this code.

name: release_node_and_decrement_count
description: Removes a node from its list and frees its memory, then decrements a count stored in the record. When the count reaches zero and a flag bit is set, it calls one more helper routine.

name: close_and_free_when_idle
description: When the record's count is zero, it removes the record from its list, closes a library, frees the record memory and returns a stored value. Otherwise it sets a pending flag bit in the record and returns zero.

name: remove_close_and_free_record
description: Removes a record from its list, closes a library, frees the record memory and returns a field stored in the record.

name: find_entry_by_id_in_list
description: Walks a packed list of entries, each with an ID longword and a length, and compares each ID with the requested value. It returns a pointer to the matching entry, or zero when the list is exhausted.

name: call_routine_return_plus_eight
description: Calls a routine and returns its integer result increased by eight. The decompiled body shown is short, so only this wrapper behaviour is visible.

name: copy_bytes_counted_loop
description: Copies bytes one at a time from a source to a destination, using a count held in a register and running until that count wraps below zero.

name: copy_bytes_test_first
description: Copies bytes from a source to a destination, testing the count before each copy and stopping when it runs out.

name: unpack_run_length_bytes
description: Decodes a packed run-length stream: a negative control byte repeats the following byte a set number of times, and a non-negative control byte copies that many literal bytes. It stops when the output count is used up.

name: unpack_repeat_control_runs
description: Decodes a run-length stream where each control byte gives a repeat count, repeating one byte for negative controls and copying literal bytes otherwise. It stops when the output count is used up.

name: invoke_routine_then_return
description: Calls one routine and returns, passing no data through.

name: write_ilbm_picture_file
description: Converts a block of 16-bit colour words into 3-byte palette entries, then writes the FORM, BMHD and BODY chunk headers through the DOS write vector. It closes the file afterwards, and the referenced chunk IDs confirm the IFF ILBM layout.

name: pad_and_finish_iff_chunk
description: Checks that a chunk length is non-negative, pads the output to a four-byte boundary when needed, and writes the closing chunk data. It closes the file in its failure path and then calls one more routine.

name: close_file_if_open
description: Closes the file through the library close vector when its handle flag is non-zero, then calls one more routine.

name: write_accumulated_row_values
description: Computes eight accumulated 32-bit values from a multiplied start value and a table, then writes them one step at a time through the DOS write vector. A negative write result is returned at once, and otherwise the start product is returned.

name: write_accumulated_row_totals
description: Computes eight accumulated values as its neighbour does, but for each step it also calls a helper and adds that helper's result to a running total. It writes through the DOS write vector and returns the total, or the write error.

name: encode_run_length_bytes
description: Encodes a byte stream into run-length form: short spans become literal blocks with a positive count, and runs of three or more identical bytes become a negative count followed by the repeated value. It returns the total encoded length.

name: encode_runs_into_buffer
description: Encodes a byte stream into run-length chunks the same way as its neighbour, writing literal blocks with a positive count and repeated runs with a negative count. It returns the encoded length.

name: encode_literal_then_repeat_runs
description: Encodes a byte stream by writing literal blocks and repeat runs, using a loop that alternates between counting identical bytes and copying the rest. It returns the encoded length.

name: count_matching_bytes_run
description: Compares a byte with the bytes that follow it and counts how many match in a row, up to 128. It stops at the limit or at the end of the data.

name: find_node_for_current_task
description: Gets the current task through exec's FindTask call, then walks a linked list starting from a record field. It returns the node whose stored task value matches, or zero when the list ends.

name: reset_field_when_flag_clear
description: Calls one routine, clears a 32-bit field in the record when the flag from that call is not set, and returns one.

name: store_value_when_nonzero
description: Calls one routine, then stores the incoming value into a record field when that value is non-zero, and returns zero.

name: compute_status_flags_from_record
description: Builds a status word from two record fields: it sets the high bit when a byte field is below five and a first value exceeds 384, and it sets bit two when a second value exceeds 279.

name: accumulate_ilbm_rows
description: When the record holds the ILBM form tag, it copies the header fields into a local table and then loops over the rows. Each row calls a selected helper to add stored values to a running sum, until the chunk is done, and it finishes by calling the close helper.

name: unpack_nibble_triples_to_words
description: Gets a data block through a helper and turns each three-byte group into one 12-bit value, stored as a 16-bit word. It returns the number of words produced.

name: call_routine_return_plus_eight
description: Calls a routine and returns its integer result increased by eight. The decompiled body shown is short, so only this wrapper behaviour is visible.

name: allocate_and_queue_task_record
description: When the flag is set, it allocates a record with AllocMem, stores the current task in it, zeroes a second field, and adds it to a list. It then increments a count in the owner record and clears the pending flag bit.
